verdict.rationale: Capsule documents a first-party, bearer-token-authenticated API for integrating custom or third-party applications, which an agent could use. Nothing in the evidence shows the specific endpoints for creating a lead, writing company data, or assigning an owner, and probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs, or OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented party/lead creation endpoints, company-data fields or enrichment via API, owner assignment via API, any MCP server, and machine-readable API specs or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: Use Capsule's API to integrate with your custom or third party application.
Each request must be authenticated with a user's Bearer token.
you can generate a token directly from your Capsule account to avoid the oAuth 2 flow.
